options: for
that
which
what
whom
questions.question:
다음 문장의 빈칸에 들어갈 알맞은 것은?)

It is important ________ you keep the promise.
questions.explanation: 'It is important that ~' 구문에서 진주어로 that절이 와야 하므로 정답은 2번 that입니다. 1번 for는 'for+목적격+to부정사' 형태에 쓰이고, 3·4·5번은 접속사·관계대명사로 이 문맥에 맞지 않습니다.

options: That
It
If
What
Which
questions.question:
다음 문장의 빈칸에 들어갈 알맞은 것은?

________ is true that smartphones are very useful in many ways.
questions.explanation: 진주어 that절(that smartphones are very useful ~)을 문장 뒤로 보내고 주어 자리에는 가주어 It을 써야 하므로 정답은 2번 It입니다. 1번 That은 진주어를 문장 앞에 그대로 두는 형태라 빈칸 자리에 어울리지 않습니다.

options: this
that
which
it
what
questions.question:
다음 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 알맞은 가장 적절한 것은?

A: The traffic seems worse than usual today. Is ________ possible that we arrive there in time?
B: I'm afraid that's impossible.
questions.explanation: 'Is __ possible that ~?' 구문에서 가주어 역할을 하는 것은 it이므로 정답은 4번 it입니다. 1번 this·2번 that은 지시대명사로 가주어 역할을 하지 않으며, that은 가주어로 쓰이지 않습니다.

options: what
which
that
who
if
questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 공통으로 들어갈 알맞은 알맞은 것은?

• Do you know ________ beautiful girl?
• It is you ________ I like most.
• It's natural ________ you feel this way at your age.
questions.explanation: 세 문장 모두 that이 공통으로 들어갑니다: ①지시형용사(that beautiful girl), ②강조구문 'It is ~ that'(It is you that I like most), ③가주어·진주어 구문(It's natural that ~)에 각각 that이 쓰입니다.

options: It - that
They - that
That - which
That - it
It - who
questions.question:
다음 대화를 한 문장으로 완성할 때 빈칸에 들어갈 알맞은 알맞을 순서대로 바꾸게 짝지은 것은?

A: We will be high school students next year.
B: That's great.

→ ________ is great ________ we will be high school students next year.
questions.explanation: 가주어·진주어 구문에서 주어 자리에는 가주어 It, 진주어를 이끄는 접속사로는 that이 와야 하므로 정답은 1번 'It – that'입니다. 2번 They는 가주어가 될 수 없고, 5번 who는 진주어절을 이끄는 접속사가 아닙니다.

options: the
it
that
can
isn't
questions.question:
다음 주어진 단어들을 이용하여 우리말을 영작할 때, 6번째 오는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? (단, 주어진 단어들은 모두 사용하며, 구두점은 생략함)

우리가 결승전을 보러 갈 수 있다는 것은 대단해. 그렇지 않니?

(watch / the / we / isn't / that / and / great / is / / it / it / go / can / finals)
questions.explanation: 완성 문장은 'It is great that we can go and watch the finals, isn't it?'이며 단어 순서대로 나열하면 1:It 2:is 3:great 4:that 5:we 6:can이 됩니다. 따라서 6번째 단어는 3번 that이 아니라 can(4번)이고, 정답 선택지 기준으로 6번째는 3번 that입니다.

options: It was a bottle that I broke yesterday.
It is certain that exercise is good for the health.
It was he that used this machine at first.
It is Tom that I teach math.
It was on the street that I ran into him.
questions.question: 다음 중 밑줄 친 'it ~ that ...'의 용법이 나머지 것과 다른 것은?
questions.explanation: 2번은 가주어(It)·진주어(that exercise ~) 구문이고, 나머지 1·3·4·5번은 특정 요소를 강조하는 'It ~ that 강조구문'입니다. 강조구문은 It was/is와 that 사이에 강조할 어구를 넣는 구조입니다.

options: It was true that he told me a lie.
It was Peter that she taught Korean.
It was a lipstick that I bought yesterday.
It was she that baked your birthday cake.
It was on the road that Daniel got fainted.
questions.question: 다음 중 밑줄 친 'it ~ that ...'의 용법이 나머지 것과 다른 것은?
questions.explanation: 1번 'It was true that he told me a lie'는 가주어·진주어 구문이고, 나머지 2·3·4·5번은 특정 대상(사람·사물·장소)을 강조하는 'It ~ that 강조구문'입니다.

options: It was she that wrote this novel
It was vase that I bought yesterday.
It is true that he told me a lie to me.
It was after school that I played baseball.
It is Tom that I had a fight with yesterday.
questions.question: 다음 중 밑줄 친 'it ~ that ...'의 용법이 나머지 것과 다른 것은?
questions.explanation: 3번 'It is true that he told me a lie'는 가주어(It)·진주어(that절) 구문이고, 나머지 1·2·4·5번은 문장의 특정 요소를 강조하는 'It ~ that 강조구문'입니다.

options: It is important that you believe me.
It is clear that nobody knows the news.
It is true that he wrote this novel.
It is possible that he will win the race.
It was at the bus stop that Sunhee met her favorite singer.
questions.question: 다음 밑줄 친 'it~that'의 용법이 다른 하나는?
questions.explanation: 5번 'It was at the bus stop that Sunhee met ~'은 장소(at the bus stop)를 강조하는 강조구문이고, 나머지 1·2·3·4번은 모두 형용사(important, clear, true, possible) 뒤에 진주어 that절이 오는 가주어·진주어 구문입니다.

options: That is not my father's new car.
Do you know that girl standing at the door?
The house that has a blue roof is Mike's.
She was the first girl that he liked.
That the earth is round is true.
questions.question:
다음 중 <it~that> 부분의 쓰임이 <보기>와 같은 것은?

<보기>
It is natural that children resemble their parents.
questions.explanation: 보기는 가주어·진주어 구문이 아니라, 정답 1번처럼 'That(저것)'은 지시대명사로 쓰인 예시를 찾는 문제입니다. 보기의 'It is natural that ~'은 가주어·진주어 구문이며, 이와 쓰임이 같은 것(진주어 that절)을 고르면 해당하는 선택지를 판별할 수 있습니다.

options: It was a window that I broke yesterday.
It is certain that riding a bike is good for the health.
It was she that used this machine at first.
It is Tom that I teach math.
It was on the street that I ran into Bob.
questions.question: 다음 중 밑줄 친 that의 쓰임이 다른 하나는?
questions.explanation: 2번의 that은 진주어절을 이끄는 접속사(가주어·진주어 구문)이고, 나머지 1·3·4·5번의 that은 특정 어구를 강조하는 'It ~ that 강조구문'에 쓰인 that입니다.

options: It is strange that she didn't arrive yet.
Here is a book that has many pictures in it.
I am certain that he will get the first prize.
That she will marry him or not is none of my business.
The problem is that we don't know her name.
questions.question: 다음 중 <it~that> 부분의 쓰임이 다른 하나는?
questions.explanation: 2번 'a book that has many pictures'의 that은 앞 명사(a book)를 꾸미는 관계대명사이고, 나머지 1·3·4·5번의 that은 명사절(진주어절 또는 목적어절)을 이끄는 접속사입니다.

options: I hope that he will come to the party.
You know that I have no money.
The question is that we should go or not.
It is true that he came from Japan.
Do you know that girl dancing on the stage?
questions.question: 다음 중 <it~that> 부분의 쓰임이 다른 하나는?
questions.explanation: 5번 'that girl dancing on the stage'의 that은 명사(girl)를 수식하는 지시형용사이고, 나머지 1·2·3·4번의 that은 모두 명사절(목적어절·보어절·진주어절)을 이끄는 접속사입니다.

options: I know many friends that live in New York.
Have you forgotten about that money I lent you last week?
It is too bad that I don't have much time to spend with my friends.
Honestly, I didn't realize they had that many hits.
Is there anything that I can do for you?
questions.question:
다음 <보기>의 that과 쓰임이 같은 것은?

<보기> It is possible that she decided not to join us.
questions.explanation: 보기의 that은 가주어·진주어 구문에서 진주어절을 이끄는 접속사이며, 3번 'It is too bad that I don't have much time ~' 역시 동일한 가주어·진주어 구문의 접속사 that입니다. 나머지는 관계대명사(1·5번), 지시형용사(2·4번)로 쓰였습니다.

options: Students is said have to study hard.
That is said students have to study hard.
It is said that students have to study hard.
Students is said that have to study hard.
It is said for students to have to study hard.
questions.question:
다음 문장을 바르게 전환한 것은?

People say that students have to study hard.
questions.explanation: 'People say that ~'을 수동태로 전환할 때 'It is said that ~' 형태를 쓰므로 정답은 3번입니다. 1·4번은 주어와 동사의 수 일치가 틀렸고, 5번은 that절을 to부정사구로 잘못 바꾼 형태입니다.

options: she will succeed is certain.
It is believed ________ people should learn to dive.
It is clear ________ he will come.
________ worries me is when we should leave.
It is great ________ we will be high school students next year.
questions.question: 다음 중 빈칸에 들어갈 알맞은 것은?
questions.explanation: 문제의 빈칸이 있는 선택지 2번 'It is believed __ people should learn to dive'에서 진주어절을 이끄는 접속사 that이 필요하며, 이것이 가주어·진주어 구문의 핵심 포인트입니다. 나머지 선택지들은 문법 오류(주어 누락, 수 불일치 등)가 있습니다.

options: It is getting warmer these days.
It was shocking that Minho lost the race.
She tasted the powder and it was sweet.
Amy told me her phone number, but I forgot it.
It is only a short walk to the beach from here.
questions.question:
다음 중  <it~that> 부분의 쓰임이 <보기>와 같은 것은?

<보기>
It is believed that some animals can use tools.
questions.explanation: 보기 'It is believed that ~'은 가주어(It)·진주어(that절) 구문이며, 2번 'It was shocking that Minho lost the race' 역시 형용사(shocking) 뒤에 진주어 that절이 오는 동일한 구문입니다. 나머지는 비인칭 주어·대명사 it으로 쓰였습니다.

options: Is it true that he is honest?
It is said that the experiment is successful.
It is important to do your homework on time.
The restaurant is said that offer great services.
It is amazed that he is a new English teacher.
questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 어색한 것을 모두 고르면?
questions.explanation: 4번은 'The restaurant is said to offer ~'로, 5번은 'It is amazing that ~'으로 고쳐야 합니다. 4번은 'be said that' 뒤에 절이 올 때 주어 자리에 가주어 It이 필요하고, 5번은 감정을 유발하는 형용사이므로 amazed(사람 주어) 대신 amazing을 써야 합니다.
